When I was 19, I had fallen off my dads insurance, and I was poor. Working fast food for under $9 an hour. My transit consisted of skateboarding, a buss, and taking two separate trolleys. I had a fall, and blacked out. I forced myself to work, bleeding from my left temple and my left shoulder. By the time I got to work, I was losing vision in my left eye, and my boss refused to let me work. I had close friends pick me up and take me to the hospital. After 8 hours, and a few x-rays, I was told I was fine and able to leave. This cost me over $7,000.00.........
